title: Data Engineer Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on programming, SQL, databases, data modelling, ETL/ELT, distributed systems, cloud platforms, orchestration, data quality and production data pipelines.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish programming, SQL, databases and computer-science fundamentals; Years 3–4 focus on distributed processing, cloud data platforms, orchestration, data quality and production-grade pipelines.

PhD routes

Move from pipeline implementation into data-platform architecture. Develop expertise in distributed systems, streaming, governance, privacy, reliability, observability and cloud economics. As AI systems consume more data, understanding how to build trustworthy, scalable data infrastructure becomes increasingly important.
